sections.title: What is QSObridge?
sections.body: QSObridge reads your log in any common format, lets you edit and validate it, and generates a valid output file. Everything runs locally in your browser — your files never leave your device.

sections.title: Loading a log
sections.body: Drag files onto the window, click ‘Load…’, or paste a log directly (Ctrl+V). You can merge multiple files. ADIF, Cabrillo, EDI, SOTA-CSV and FLE are auto-detected; a plain CSV/XLSX opens a column mapping.

sections.title: Editing in the grid
sections.body: Click a cell to change it; Enter or Tab moves on. Columns adapt to your data — use ‘Columns…’ to show any present field. Filter by band/mode/call, sort a column, select rows, bulk-edit or find/replace, with undo/redo (Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y).

sections.title: Validation
sections.body: Pick a profile: required or invalid fields get a red border with tooltip, and the band-plan check flags freq/band mismatches. Use ‘→ Next error’ to step through them. ‘Find dupes’ marks duplicates.

sections.title: Profiles
sections.body: 18 contest and activation profiles are built in (POTA, WWFF, SOTA, GMA, IOTA, UBA DX, CQ WW/WPX, IARU, ARRL, VHF-EDI …). Each defines the required fields and the exchange. You can import or share a profile as JSON.

sections.title: Exporting
sections.body: Pick the target format at the bottom. ‘Export fields…’ chooses which fields to include — by default this follows your profile (POTA the park refs, IOTA serial + ref, etc.). ‘Preview’ shows the file; ‘Convert & download’ saves it. Formats without custom fields get a loss warning + sidecar.

sections.title: Upload wizard
sections.body: Not sure which format? Pick your destination (LoTW, eQSL, QRZ, Club Log, POTA, WWFF, SOTA, contest…) and the tool sets the right format and profile. For LoTW you get a conformant ADIF; sign it afterwards with TQSL.

sections.title: Offline & saving
sections.body: Install QSObridge as an app (PWA) to work offline — ideal for portable. Your work is auto-saved and offered for restore after a restart; your station details are remembered.

sections.title: Responsibility
sections.body: Made by ON3VZ. Always check your output files before submission — rules and exchanges change. Use at your own risk.

ai.title: AI assist
ai.paste: Paste a rough or paper log
ai.note: Free text only. Output = suggestions (editable). The key stays local; calls go straight from your browser to the provider.
